messages:
ivan: heads-up, production auth errors hitting a small subset of POST /v1/generate calls since key rotation at 14:03 UTC.

ivan: error stack from edge node:
```
ERROR auth: sig_validation_failed kid=abC123 token_id=tok_9f
reason=missing_verification_key
```

elaine: assigned. Do we have repro?

ivan: yes. Saw it on tenant acme-inc. Repro steps:
1) rotate signing key in staging (signed new short-lived token)
2) send curl with Authorization: Bearer <token>
3) some instances return 401 with above error, others OK.

ivan: curl used:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer <jwt_signed_with_new_kid>" \n -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

support-l2: logs show jwks fetch returned 200 with new key, but downstream cache module still holds previous keyset. Maybe stale ETag handling.

tom: I see a race: our jwks cache has TTL=60s and conditional GET uses If-None-Match -> 304. If ETag changed but app interpreted 304 as "no change" and skipped merging new keys due to wrong header handling, new kid never added.

elaine: can you paste the instance-local jwks cache dump where error occurred?

ivan: attached excerpt:
```
cached_jwks: [{"kid":"oldK1"},{"kid":"oldK2"}]
last_fetch: 2025-08-01T14:02:58Z
etag: "W/oldtag"
```

support-l2: production jwks endpoint logs:
```
14:02:46 GET /jwks -> 200 ETag="W/newtag" body contained kid=abC123
14:02:47 GET /jwks -> 304 ETag="W/newtag"
```

tom: oh — instances fetching immediately after rotation might get 304 because we returned new ETag earlier to some CDN edge; but our client incorrectly ignores updated body when 304 paired with different Date header. Root cause likely cache merge bug.

elaine: mitigation: bump jwks cache TTL to 300s and force-refresh on rotation events. Also add a one-time purge endpoint to clear local caches for affected nodes.

ivan: temporary workaround for customers: reissue tokens with "kid" fallback to old key for 10 minutes.

support-l2: filed incident INC-2025-489, tagging oncall. I'll follow up with repro steps and patch PR.

security-bot: Reminder: add unit test to jwks client for 304/ETag merge and add regression check in canary.

ivan: thanks — keeping oncall looped. :thumbsup:
